en.answer: In the proposed scenario, since the effect of <<7858>> is being applied, cards cannot be banished, but the part of the effect that prevents you from Normal or Special Summoning other monsters is still applied.
en.question: If <<7858>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11713>> that banishes cards, how does this resolve?
en.title: If <<7858>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the effect of <<11713>> that banishes cards, how does this resolve?

ja.answer: 質問の状況の場合、「<<7858>>」の効果が適用されていますので、カードを除外する処理は適用されませんが、『この効果を発動するターン、自分は他のモンスターを通常召喚・特殊召喚できない』は適用される事になります。
